steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the requested vendor-addition configuration.
Apply the requested stage-addition configuration.
Provide the required draft title.
Apply a pricing template so the draft has a valid configured stage.
Add one line item to create a meaningful saved draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the saved draft has schedule data to preserve.
Create the saved eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab.
Verify the newly saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Open the created draft from the Drafts list.
Open the Upload Attachments window.
Verify the expected attachment window opened.
Cancel the attachment operation.
Verify that cancelling closes the Upload Attachments window.
Verify cancellation did not produce an application error.
Return to the events list to verify the draft still exists.
View the Drafts tab after cancellation.
Verify the event remains a draft after cancelling attachments.
